about_short_description.short_description: Print-Life is a platform that offers artificial intelligence solutions and 3D cloud printing services.

product.name: 3D Cloud Printing Services
product.description: Provides 3D printing solutions for creating patient-specific models from CT and MRI scans for use in medical diagnostics and surgical planning.

product.name: Artificial Intelligence Solutions
product.description: Utilizes AI to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of medical imaging analysis, aiding in the transformation of images into 3D models for surgical use.

product.name: Patient-specific Reference Models
product.description: Offers custom 3D printed models for various medical specialties including orthopedics, cardiovascular, and oncology to assist in preoperative planning and reduce surgical risks.

product.name: Support and Maintenance Services
product.description: Provides comprehensive support for the setup, management, and maintenance of 3D printing technology in medical facilities, including necessary hardware, software, and training.
